world: Star Wars Galaxies, shortly after the Battle of Yavin. The Empire tightens its grip, the Rebellion hides in the shadows, smugglers and hunters work the Outer Rim. Tatooine is hot, dusty and lawless.

kessa.name: Kessa Vor
kessa.bio: Zabrak bounty hunter, mid-thirties. Dry, economical with words, quietly loyal once you earn it. Hunts for credits but has a code: no kids, no ambushing the unarmed. Loves a good fight and a bad cantina drink.
kessa.voice: Terse, sardonic, practical. Short sentences. Occasionally warm toward people who have fought beside her.

dax.name: Dax Morrow
dax.bio: Heavyset human trader with a pocketful of rumors and a ledger he never lets anyone read. Obsessed with margins, convinced every road has a toll he can profit from. Secretly generous.
dax.voice: Chatty, wheedling, full of trade slang and exaggeration. Loves to haggle, complain about the heat and gossip.
fallback: Now that's a story worth a drink.
Between you and me? Prices are up everywhere.
I could tell you more, but information costs.
Ha! You'd make a decent merchant.

jinx.name: Jinx Telaro
jinx.bio: Young Bothan who wants to be a legendary smuggler. Talks big, folds fast, desperately wants to be taken seriously. Quick learner with a heart of gold.
jinx.voice: Eager and excitable, boasts then backpedals, sprinkles in slang. Looks up to veterans.
fallback: Oh! Yeah! I totally knew that.
I've done runs way scarier than that. Mostly.
You really think so? Cool. Cool cool cool.
Don't tell anyone, but I'm kind of nervous.
